title: The 3 Best Dog Crates Under $150
metaDescription: Our 3 picks for dog crates under $150, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at dog crates under $150 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Carlson Pet Products Double Door Metal Dog Crate, Large 42-Inch
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $90 to $110, Rated up to 95 lbs, Multi-point locking latches.
strengths: Best balance of price and sturdiness in this range
Multi-point latches are a real upgrade over single slide-bolts
42-inch size and 95 lb rating cover most large breeds
limitations: Heavier than budget crates to move between rooms
Still wire construction, not for the most extreme chewers
No wheels included at this price

products.name: Go Pet Club 44-Inch Heavy Duty Stackable Dog Crate
products.blurb: Key specs: Typically $130 to $150, Heaviest wire gauge in this roundup, Stackable up to three tiers.
strengths: Thickest wire gauge available at this price point
Wheels genuinely help moving a crate this large
Stacking is useful for households or small kennels with multiple dogs
limitations: At the top of this price range
Some reports of weld quality issues on individual units
Assembly goes faster with two people
features: Heaviest wire gauge in this roundup
Includes wheels and two water bowls
